description_en: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: Two curved woven panels hold an empty vertical napkin slot between them. Side: A narrow bamboo foot bridges the panels and resists tipping. Rear: The rear panel has a complete woven surface and concealed lower bindings. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.
